To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
MyoD is an essential activator of the Notch regulatory cascade, which in turn is involved in muscle determination in vertebrates.
MyoD is required for mesodermal Delta1 expression, and MyoD‐induced Delta1 expression in turn triggers Notch signaling, which is necessary to promote myogenesis in Xenopus gastrular mesoderm.
MyoD stimulates transcription of the Notch‐ligand Delta‐1, thereby activating the Notch‐dependent regulatory circuitry in prospective muscle cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the molecular mechanisms of muscle determination in Xenopus laevis.
the molecular mechanisms of cell fate determination and differentiation.
the role of MyoD as a positive regulator of the Delta‐1 ligand in Xenopus mesodermal cells and its implications in the regulation of Notch signalling.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
MyoD stimulates Delta-1 transcription and triggers the Notch pathway in the mesoderm, which may contribute to the determination of muscle progenitors.
the myogenic determination program, which is regulated by the basic helix– loop–helix protein MyoD, involves Notch as a positive regulator of the myoblast fate.
the MyoD‐Delta‐1‐Notch pathway is a positive feedback loop, which is required for myogenesis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

MyoD activates the expression of the Notch‐ligand Delta‐1 during myogenesis, thereby triggering a Notch‐regulated gene expression program that includes the expression of the muscle regulatory factors themselves, as well as other genes involved in muscle determination.
MyoD stimulates Delta1 expression, and this stimulates Notch signaling, which in turn represses MyoD expression.
MyoD is an upstream regulator of Notch signaling in myogenesis.
The main takeaway from our work is that
MyoD can activate transcription of Delta‐1 in myoblasts.
MyoD, a key muscle determination factor, is also a key regulator of the Notcch signaling cascade in myogenesis.
MyoD is not only a master regulator of muscle differentiation, but is also a key player in muscle cell specification, a process that involves the activation of the Notch pathway.
